rounds: Round 1 redraws the originals; round 2 refines the previous sheets with --refine-from. Selection uses processed round-2 outputs.

build_cfg.note: Adopted build settings (pass as --cfg): a partial lightness lock keeps the redraw's sun-side highlights and crown shade, a stronger volume pass gives the crown mass at RTS size; hue family and chroma stay locked to each map's original.

descriptions.TREE01: a tall narrow poplar-like tree with a dense, slightly ovate olive-green column of foliage and a thin trunk with a few upward branches at the base
descriptions.TREE02: a broad low fruit tree (crabapple / hawthorn) with an airy, twiggy rounded crown of small fresh-green leaves and a few tiny red fruits
descriptions.TREE03: a young deciduous tree with a forked trunk and two clumped, dark olive-green crowns
descriptions.TREE04: a wide windswept tree with long near-horizontal branches and bright yellow-green leaf clusters
descriptions.TREE05: a dense round broadleaf tree with a compact dark-green crown
descriptions.TREE06: a large spreading oak with a broad dome crown of big dark-green leaf clusters and a short thick trunk
descriptions.TREE07: a sparse young deciduous tree with an open, see-through crown of small olive-green leaf clusters
descriptions.TREE08: a broad dense elm-like tree with olive / khaki-green foliage
descriptions.TREE09: a very narrow columnar Lombardy poplar, bright green, with a thin trunk
descriptions.TREE10: an open branching tree whose leaves grow in separate clumps at the branch tips, fresh green, thin dark branches
descriptions.TREE11: a dense maple in early autumn: olive-green crown mixed with rusty red-brown leaves
descriptions.TREE12: a small ornamental tree (photinia-like) with green leaves and reddish-bronze young leaves at the top
descriptions.TREE13: a large weeping willow with long hanging curtains of thin yellow-green leaves and a thick dark trunk
descriptions.TREE14: a smaller weeping willow with drooping yellow-green foliage
descriptions.TREE15: a dense tree with dull autumn olive-brown / khaki foliage
descriptions.TREE17: a round olive-green bush with small leaves
descriptions.TREE19: a low twiggy shrub with many thin upright olive-green twigs (broom / heather-like)
